Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:192991
Court No. - 66
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 33958 of 2024

Applicant :- Pappu@ Vinod
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- J.B. Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Virendra Kumar Srivastava
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Heard Sri J.B. Singh, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Virendra Kumar Srivastava, learned counsel for the informant and Sri Pradeep Kumar, learned AGA for the State.
2. The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 24 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Basauni,
District Agra during pendency of the trial.
3.

Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is father-in-law of the deceased and on the basis of false allegation of demand of dowry and torture, he has been made accused in the present matter along with his other family members including husband of the deceased.
4. He further submits, actually deceased always pressurized her husband to live in her paternal home since after marriage and when her husband could not ready for the same then only due to this reason she within eight months of her marriage consumed some poisonous substance and died.

sentences.text:
He further submits, during post mortem cause of death could not be ascertained and viscera was preserved and now viscera report is on record and from its perusal it reflects that deceased consumed Aluminum Phosphide, therefore, at this stage, it cannot be said that it is not a case of suicidal death.
6.

He further submits, immediately after the incident husband of the deceased has taken her to the hospital and this fact is evident from page-55 of the paper-book but in spite of best medical treatment she died and this fact shows the bona fide on the part of the applicant side.

7. He further submits, bail application of mother-in-law of the deceased has already been allowed by this Court vide order dated 25.11.2024 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 43133 of 2024 and on facts, case of applicant is at par with her.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 43133 of 2024
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 8. He further submits, there is no specific allegation against the applicant and he is not having any criminal history and in the present matter he is in jail since 29.06.2024 i.e for last more than five months.

9. Per contra, learned AGA as well as learned counsel for the informant opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that daughter-in-law of the applicant died within eight months of her marriage in her matrimonial home under abnormal circumstances and there is also allegation of demand of dowry but could not dispute the fact that applicant is father-in-law of the deceased and there is no specific allegation against him.

They further could not dispute the fact that from page-55 of the paper-book,
it reflects that after the incident husband of the deceased has taken her to the hospital and deceased died due to consumption of Aluminum Phosphide.
They further could not dispute the fact that mother-in-law of the deceased has already been released on bail by this Court.
10. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

11. However, daughter-in-law of the applicant died within eight months of her marriage in her matrimonial home under abnormal circumstances and there is also allegation of demand of dowry but applicant is father-in-law of the deceased and there is no specific allegation against him.
12. Further, from the document of the hospital, which has been annexed at page-55 of the paper-book, it reflects, husband of the deceased himself had taken the deceased to the hospital.

13. Further, viscera report suggests that deceased died due to consumption of Aluminum Phosphide,
therefore, at this stage, it cannot be said that it is not a case of suicidal death.
14.
Further, applicant is not having any criminal history and in the present matter he is in jail since 29.06.2024 i.e for last more than five months.
15. Further, mother-in-law of the deceased has already been released on bail by this Court.

sentences.text:
Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
17. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

18. Let the applicant - Pappu@ Vinod be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
19.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

20. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
